primary_contract: Extract, normalize, version, diff, and validate formula and parameter bundles from source-discovered manifests and workbook artifacts
completion_policy: complete-with-gaps means the source-only canary and strict bundle contracts are implemented, but the bundle must not be presented as parity-validated or publication-ready until gap_blockers are closed

gap_blockers.description: Official SAS and Excel extraction is not complete for release-grade formula and parameter bundles.
The committed bundle is source-only and must not be presented as parity validated until stream/year fixture evidence closes the extraction gaps.

promotion_requirements: Close source-discovered extraction gaps with official SAS/Excel extraction evidence.
Add fixture-backed parity evidence for each claimed stream/year bundle.
Keep source evidence and deterministic bundle diffs stable for review.
description: Build a versioned formula and parameter bundle pipeline for future IHACPA calculator releases, anchored to explicit source-discovered gap records and source-scanner fixtures.
